Frontend Playwright: full create→list→delete flow against real Meta Graph API v25.0 succeeded. All Catalan i18n strings render correctly. Multi-tenant isolation regression on /api/conversations and /api/agents passes.

backend_endpoints: GET /api/admin/templates → 200, returns prova_test + hello_world with full shape (id/name/status/category/language/components)

Send-test modal opens with template-send-phone input

Catalan i18n keys verified: templates.create_new='Nova plantilla', templates.create_title='Crear nova plantilla', templates.delete_title='Eliminar plantilla', templates.cancel='Cancel·lar', plus all field_* keys

critical_code_review_comments: MINOR: routers/templates.py POST /send returns HTTP 200 even when Meta send failed (ok:false). Acceptable for Meta App Review screencast since the endpoint demonstrates whatsapp_business_management permission, but consider returning 4xx on Meta-side validation failure for stricter API contract.

MINOR: POST /admin/templates auto-lowercases & replaces spaces in name silently. Frontend already sanitises on input, so OK, but server should also reject leading digits per Meta spec (Meta itself will reject; current 4xx propagation works).
MINOR: get_admin_user catches generic Exception and returns 401. If Supabase is down it would mask 5xx; consider differentiating network errors from auth errors.
INFO: AdminPage.js is 1319 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting TemplatesSection, AccountSection, WebhookSection, AuditSection into separate files for maintainability.
